{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] 
* 1 large ripe [[Cookbook:Plantain|plantain]] 

== Procedure ==

# Heat oil in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] over low heat. 
# Peel plantain, and cut it horizontally or in circular slices.  
# Add plantains to frying pan and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] on both sides for about 1 minute or until golden brown. 
# Drain, cool, and enjoy!
